disableDrawerSensor.title: Disable Drawer Level Sensor
disableDrawerSensor.description: Disables monitoring of the drawer level sensor.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: If enabled, the plugin will log verbose debug information.

completedPulseSeconds.title: Cycle Completed: pulse seconds
completedPulseSeconds.description: How long the 'Cycle Completed' switch stays ON before auto-reset.

interruptedTimeoutMinutes.title: Interrupted timeout minutes
interruptedTimeoutMinutes.description: If a clean remains 'in progress' beyond this many minutes, trigger the 'Cycle Interrupted Timeout' switch. 0 = disabled.

interruptedTimeoutPulseSeconds.title: Interrupted Timeout: pulse seconds
interruptedTimeoutPulseSeconds.description: How long the 'Cycle Interrupted Timeout' switch stays ON before auto-reset.

ccpMaxMinutes.title: Max CLEAN duration before fallback interrupt (minutes)
ccpMaxMinutes.description: If 'Clean In Progress' (ccp) lasts longer than this, treat it as an interrupted/stalled cycle and fire the timeout switch.
